unit.title: Numbers to 10
unit.blurb: Counting objects to 10, reading and writing numbers and number words, one more and one less, and comparing numbers.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Count up to 10 objects and match numbers to number words.

O2.t: Compare and order numbers to 10, and find one more or one less.

p: When we **count**, we touch each object **once** and say one number for each: one, two, three… The **last number** we say tells us **how many**.
A **ten frame** has two rows of 5. A full row is **5**. A full frame is **10**. We can see how many without counting every dot.
If objects are muddled, move each one to a line as you count it so you do not count it twice.

vocab.def: say one number for each thing

p: **One more** than a number is the next number when we count. **One less** is the number just before. One more than 6 is 7. One less than 6 is 5.
Match objects one to one. The group with some left over has **more**. The other group has **fewer**.
Three elephants are not 'more' than five mice. Count the objects – do not look at how big they are.
